description: This file defines the 'soap_transport_http' class, a transport implementation for sending and receiving SOAP messages over HTTP and HTTPS protocols, using either raw sockets or cURL extensions. It supports features such as authentication, proxy configuration, HTTP headers manipulation, chunked transfer decoding, content encoding handling, and persistent connections.
external_files: depends on standard PHP functions and cURL extensions

classes.name: soap_transport_http
classes.description: A transport class that manages sending and receiving SOAP messages over HTTP/HTTPS, supporting both socket connections and cURL, with capabilities for authentication, proxy configuration, cookies, and content encoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the transport object with the target URL, optional cURL options, and whether to force cURL use.

methods.name: setCurlOption
methods.description: Sets an individual cURL option for the current cURL handle.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets an HTTP header to be included in the request.

methods.name: unsetHeader
methods.description: Removes an HTTP header from the request headers.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Parses and sets the connection URL and associated components; updates headers accordingly.

methods.name: io_method
methods.description: Determines whether to use socket, curl, or unknown for network communication.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket or cURL connection based on configuration, handling timeouts and SSL settings.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a SOAP message and retrieves the response, handling retries.

methods.name: sendHTTPS
methods.description: Deprecated method alias for send; invokes send() method.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials for basic, digest, certificate, or NTLM authentication.

methods.name: setSOAPAction
methods.description: Sets the SOAPAction HTTP header.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Enables HTTP content encoding (gzip, deflate) for requests.

methods.name: setProxy
methods.description: Configures HTTP proxy settings.

methods.name: isSkippableCurlHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header line in cURL response should be ignored.

methods.name: decodeChunked
methods.description: Decodes HTTP chunked transfer encoding.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs the full HTTP request payload with headers and data.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Transmits the HTTP request via socket or cURL.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Receives and processes the HTTP response, including headers and payload, handling redirects and authentication challenges.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header for the HTTP request.

methods.name: usePersistentConnection
methods.description: Enables HTTP persistent connections (Keep-Alive).

methods.name: parseCookie
methods.description: Parses a Set-Cookie header string into its parts.

methods.name: getCookiesForRequest
methods.description: Prepares cookies for inclusion in the request header, based on domain, path, expiration, and security.
